structures_or_apparatus: all-silicon test structures with long narrow lateral channels

claims: The fitting gives the equilibrium constant of adsorption and the sticking coefficient.
The simulations predict the experimental measurement results quite well for Al2O3 and TiO2 ALD processes.
The model presented here describes quite well the thickness distribution of ALD growth in narrow channels.
This model can be used to design and optimize a deposition process for a new device.
By fitting the model to the measured thickness distribution, one obtains parameters of the growth reaction model used.
